title: Active Learning for Efficient Annotation of Surgical Videos with Weak Supervision
summary: Precise spatial-temporal annotation of laparoscopic videos is time-consuming and requires expert knowledge. We propose a human-in-the-loop knowledge acquisition framework that combines active learning with dual-loss optimization to significantly reduce the annotation effort needed for automatic localization and segmentation of objects in the surgical field. Our method employs a foundation model to generate temporally consistent class activation maps (CAMs) from video using two complementary training objectives: a weak supervision loss on video-level tool presence labels for weakly annotated data, and an image-level mask loss on human-corrected annotations obtained through active learning. Rather than requiring dense pixel-level annotation upfront, our pipeline iteratively proposes pseudo-masks that guide the expert annotator to refine the knowledge previously captured by the model. We demonstrate that our framework reduces the effort of surgical video annotation by 50% by the end of training in comparison to fully manual annotation. Through eliminating the need for large, fully annotated datasets from the start, this framework enables scalability to the development of surgical tool segmentation models. This iterative human-in-the-loop refinement supports efficient knowledge acquisition with minimal expert input, providing a practical and deployable strategy for expanding tool segmentation to larger, more diverse datasets and real-world clinical settings.
tldr: Proposes a human-in-the-loop active learning framework with weak supervision to reduce surgical video annotation effort by 50% via iterative refinement of pseudo-masks from a foundation model.
tldr_zh: 提出一种结合主动学习和弱监督的人机协同框架，通过迭代优化基础模型生成的伪掩模，将手术视频标注工作量减少50%。
summary_zh: 腹腔镜视频的精确时空标注耗时且需要专业知识。我们提出了一种人在回路的知识获取框架，该框架结合主动学习与双损失优化，显著减少了手术视野中物体自动定位与分割所需的标注工作量。我们的方法采用基础模型，通过两个互补的训练目标从视频中生成时序一致的类激活图：针对弱标注数据的视频级工具存在标签的弱监督损失，以及通过主动学习获取的人工修正标注的图像级掩码损失。该流程无需预先密集的像素级标注，而是迭代地提出伪掩码，引导专家标注者完善模型先前捕获的知识。我们证明，与完全人工标注相比，该框架在训练结束时将手术视频标注工作量减少了50%。通过消除初始阶段对大规模完全标注数据集的需求，该框架实现了手术工具分割模型的可扩展开发。这种迭代式人在回路优化策略以最少的专家输入支持高效知识获取，为将工具分割扩展到更大规模、更多样化的数据集及真实临床环境提供了实用且可部署的策略。

title: Marker-free deformable registration and fusion for augmented reality-guided positive margin localization during tumor resection surgery
summary: Positive margins in head and neck oncologic surgery require mapping specimen-side pathology findings to the patient resection bed. This is challenging because pathologists identify the positive margin on slices of the resected, deformed specimen, while surgeons must relocate the corresponding site on the resection bed using only verbal descriptions and no visual guidance. We present a marker-free augmented reality (AR) workflow for mapping a margin label from a three-dimensional specimen scan to the resection bed. The method combines contour-constrained deformation, residual alignment to a depth scan, surface-based fusion to a head-mounted display, and target projection onto the reconstructed bed. Bead-suture correspondences estimate specimen deformation, whereas patient-to-display fusion does not require external fiducial markers. Following formative experiments, five residents and surgeons performed cadaveric cheek and scalp re-resection tasks under verbal guidance, verbal guidance with specimen examination, and AR guidance. Deformation target errors were $7.63 \pm 3.74$ mm for the cheek and $3.72 \pm 1.02$ mm for the scalp; residual specimen-to-bed distances were $2.43 \pm 2.15$ mm and $2.19 \pm 1.06$ mm, respectively. Fusion error did not differ significantly between marker-free and marker-based methods on either cadaver; overall marker-free fusion error was $2.15 \pm 0.87$ mm. End-to-end margin localization error decreased from $21.40 \pm 3.84$ mm with verbal guidance and $16.09 \pm 4.30$ mm with specimen examination to $6.19 \pm 1.79$ mm with AR guidance ($p < 0.001$). Online fusion required $5.23 \pm 0.34$ s. These results demonstrate effective marker-free AR guidance for positive-margin localization and support more precise tumor resection.
tldr: Presents a marker-free augmented reality workflow that uses deformable registration and surface fusion to map positive margin labels from resected specimen scans to the patient's resection bed, achieving significantly lower localization error than verbal guidance in cadaver experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无标记增强现实工作流程，利用变形配准和表面融合将切除标本扫描中的阳性切缘标签映射到患者手术切除床，在尸体实验中实现了比口头引导显著更低的定位误差。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
头颈肿瘤外科手术中的阳性切缘问题要求将标本侧的病理学发现映射到患者切除床。这一过程极具挑战性，因为病理学家是在切除后变形的标本切片上识别阳性切缘，而外科医生仅凭口头描述且无视觉引导，必须在切除床上重新定位对应部位。我们提出了一种无标记增强现实工作流程，用于将三维标本扫描中的切缘标记映射至切除床。该方法结合了轮廓约束变形、深度扫描残余对齐、头戴式显示器的表面融合以及目标在重建切除床上的投影。缝线珠对应关系用于估计标本变形，而患者与显示器的融合无需外部基准标记。经过预实验后，五名住院医师和外科医生在口头引导、口头引导联合标本检查以及增强现实引导下，完成了尸体颊部和头皮再切除任务。颊部变形目标误差为7.63 ± 3.74 mm，头皮为3.72 ± 1.02 mm；标本到切除床的残余距离分别为2.43 ± 2.15 mm和2.19 ± 1.06 mm。在两名尸体上，无标记方法与有标记方法的融合误差无显著差异；整体无标记融合误差为2.15 ± 0.87 mm。端到端切缘定位误差从口头引导下的21.40 ± 3.84 mm和标本检查下的16.09 ± 4.30 mm降低至增强现实引导下的6.19 ± 1.79 mm（p < 0.001）。在线融合所需时间为5.23 ± 0.34秒。这些结果表明，无标记增强现实引导能有效定位阳性切缘，并支持更精准的肿瘤切除。

title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
summary: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.
tldr: Proposes a learned state estimator combining MLP and PCA latent representation with geometry-aware regularization to reconstruct full deformable mesh from sparse observations, achieving 98.1% of oracle performance in simulated surgical tissue retraction.
tldr_zh: 提出一种结合MLP和PCA潜在表示与几何感知正则化的学习型状态估计器，从稀疏观测中重建完整形变网格，在模拟手术组织牵拉中达到98.1%的oracle性能。
summary_zh: 手术组织牵拉需要在部分且嘈杂的感知条件下进行有效的操作规划。我们研究了可变形组织牵拉的状态估计问题，其中在决策时刻仅能获得组织表面的稀疏观测。我们提出了一种学习型状态估计器，该估计器能从40个带有噪声的顶点观测中重建完整的可变形网格状态。该估计器将多层感知器与低维PCA潜在表示相结合，并采用几何感知正则化进行训练，以鼓励光滑且物理合理的变形。我们通过单步和多步牵拉规划在二维可变形薄片模拟中评估了该方法。结果表明，在多步牵拉中，学习型估计器达到了理想性能的98.1%，同时支持高效推理。这些结果证明了在现实感知约束下，基于几何正则化的学习型状态估计能够支持有效的可变形操作。

title: Towards end-to-end optimization in multimaterial 3D printing
summary: Multimaterial 3D printing enables the fabrication of functionally graded components, but optimizing their spatial material distribution alongside structural topology remains a formidable challenge due to high-dimensional design spaces and complex constitutive modeling. This paper presents an end-to-end computational framework integrating sparsified physics-augmented neural networks with finite-element-based topology optimization. By extracting closed-form, composition-aware hyperelastic constitutive laws from experimental data, this approach facilitates exact symbolic differentiation via the adjoint state method implemented with FEniCSx, efficiently circumventing the bottlenecks of applying neural network constitutive models. This pipeline is deployed on soft robotic gripper applications, demonstrating continuous composition optimization for highly anisotropic contact responses, and the concurrent optimization of macroscopic topology and material distribution under non-failure stretch constraints. This methodology could replace laborious empirical prototyping, establishing interpretable machine-learning models as practical, robust design primitives for advanced multimaterial additive manufacturing.
tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end computational framework that integrates sparsified physics-augmented neural networks with topology optimization to simultaneously optimize material distribution and structural topology in multimaterial 3D printing, demonstrated on soft robotic grippers for anisotropic contact responses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端计算框架，将稀疏化的物理增强神经网络与拓扑优化相结合，以同时优化多材料3D打印中的材料分布和结构拓扑，并在软体机器人夹爪上展示了各向异性接触响应的优化。
summary_zh: 多材料3D打印技术能够制造功能梯度构件，但由于高维设计空间和复杂本构建模，优化其空间材料分布与结构拓扑仍是一项艰巨挑战。本文提出了一种端到端计算框架，将稀疏化物理增强神经网络与基于有限元的拓扑优化相结合。通过从实验数据中提取封闭形式的、成分感知的超弹性本构定律，该方法利用FEniCSx实现的伴随状态法实现精确符号微分，有效规避了应用神经网络本构模型的瓶颈。该流程被部署于软体机器人夹爪应用，展示了针对高度各向异性接触响应的连续成分优化，以及在非破坏拉伸约束下宏观拓扑与材料分布的协同优化。该方法可替代繁冗的经验原型设计，将可解释机器学习模型确立为先进多材料增材制造的实用、稳健的设计基元。

title: A Self-Evolving Agent for Longitudinal Personal Health Management
summary: Personal health management unfolds over repeated encounters, yet most health AI systems treat each request in isolation. We developed HealthClaw, an open-source agent architecture that updates support as a person's routines, preferences, measurements and risks change. It separates shared safety rules and medical knowledge from private longitudinal memory containing profile facts, reusable procedures and episodic traces. After each episode, induction determines what should update the profile, revise a procedure, remain episodic or be excluded. We evaluated HealthClaw with a synthetic year-long benchmark and nine 200-case biomedical tasks. Across 900 longitudinal support probes, answer accuracy increased from 0.2% with current-query prompting to 45.7% with HealthClaw, while prompt-side context exposure was 71.7% lower than with full-history prompting. In 100 privacy probes, HealthClaw produced higher privacy-aware answer quality and fewer unsafe disclosures than both baselines. Across the biomedical tasks, the mean absolute gain in the task-specific primary metric was 27.0 percentage points, and seven gains remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. These offline benchmarks support governed, self-evolving memory for longitudinal personal health agents, although clinical effectiveness requires prospective evaluation. HealthClaw is publicly available at https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw.
tldr: HealthClaw is an open-source, self-evolving agent architecture for longitudinal personal health management that separates shared knowledge from private memory and uses induction to update profiles, procedures, and episodic traces, achieving large accuracy gains and privacy improvements over baseline methods.
tldr_zh: HealthClaw 是一个开源、自我进化的智能体架构，用于纵向个人健康管理，它将共享知识与私人记忆分离，并通过归纳更新个人档案、操作流程和事件轨迹，相比基线方法在准确性和隐私保护方面取得了显著提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
个人健康管理在反复的交互中逐步展开，然而大多数健康人工智能系统却孤立地处理每次请求。我们开发了HealthClaw，这是一种开源智能体架构，能够随着个人日常习惯、偏好、测量指标和风险的变化而更新支持策略。该架构将共享的安全规则和医学知识与私有的纵向记忆（包括个人档案事实、可复用流程及情节痕迹）分离开来。每次交互后，归纳机制会判断哪些信息应更新档案、修订流程、保留为情节记录或予以排除。我们通过一个合成的一年期基准测试和九项200例生物医学任务对HealthClaw进行了评估。在900次纵向支持探测中，回答准确率从基于当前查询提示的0.2%提升至HealthClaw的45.7%，同时提示侧上下文暴露量比基于完整历史记录的提示降低了71.7%。在100次隐私探测中，HealthClaw相较于两个基线方法，产生了更高的隐私感知回答质量，且不安全披露更少。在生物医学任务中，任务特定主要指标的平均绝对增益为27.0个百分点，其中七项增益在错误发现率校正后仍具显著性。这些离线基准测试支持了面向纵向个人健康智能体的受控、自演进记忆机制，但其临床有效性仍需前瞻性评估。HealthClaw已公开于 https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw。

title: Towards Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in 2D medical image understanding, their extension to 3D volumetric imaging remains hindered by prohibitive annotation costs and dataset opacity. Current data formats, predominantly consisting of rigid Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs or unstructured final clinical reports, typically fail to capture explicit clinical reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale structured reasoning dataset constructed via a novel slice-wise data synthesis paradigm. Inspired by the genuine diagnostic workflow of radiologists, this paradigm models visual cognition by decomposing the complex 3D reading process, translating global clinical priors into fine-grained, per-slice observations that are subsequently synthesized into an interpretable Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Crucially, this synthesized reasoning framework enforces essential clinical principles: sequential spatial tracking, multi-slice spatial awareness for artifact mitigation, and differential exclusion. To validate this approach, we instruction-tune a standard 2D-pretrained MLLM baseline using the synthesized data to enhance its volumetric comprehension. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple 3D medical benchmarks demonstrate that our method yields significant performance improvements over the 2D baseline. Furthermore, the resulting model exhibits robust spatial reasoning capabilities and rivals resource-intensive native 3D architectures, effectively bridging the performance gap. Ultimately, this data-centric strategy unlocks deep volumetric understanding and highly interpretable clinical logic without requiring computationally expensive 3D-specific pre-training. The complete repository, including datasets and training workflows, is publicly available at https://github.com/2020420145009/hounsfield.
tldr: The paper introduces a slice-wise data synthesis paradigm and Chain-of-Thought reasoning to enhance 3D spatial reasoning in medical multimodal large language models, achieving performance comparable to native 3D architectures without 3D-specific pre-training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于逐切片数据合成范式和推理链的方法，增强医学多模态大语言模型的3D空间推理能力，无需3D特定预训练即可达到与原生3D架构相当的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在二维医学图像理解方面取得了显著成功，但其向三维体成像的扩展仍受到高昂标注成本和数据集不透明性的阻碍。当前的数据格式主要由固定的视觉问答（VQA）对或非结构化的最终临床报告构成，通常无法捕捉显式的临床推理过程。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种通过新颖的逐切片数据合成范式构建的大规模结构化推理数据集。该范式受放射科医生真实诊断流程启发，通过分解复杂的3D阅读过程来模拟视觉认知，将全局临床先验转化为细粒度的逐切片观察，随后将这些观察综合成可解释的思维链（CoT）。至关重要的是，这一合成推理框架强制执行了关键的临床原则：顺序空间追踪、用于伪影减轻的多切片空间感知，以及鉴别性排除。为验证该方法，我们利用合成数据对标准2D预训练MLLM基线进行指令微调，以增强其体理解能力。在多个3D医学基准上的全面评估表明，我们的方法相较于2D基线取得了显著的性能提升。此外，所得模型展现出强大的空间推理能力，可与资源密集型的原生3D架构相媲美，有效弥合了性能差距。最终，这种以数据为中心的策略无需进行计算昂贵的3D专用预训练，即可实现深层的体理解释和高度可解释的临床逻辑。完整代码库（包括数据集和训练工作流）已公开于 https://github.com/2020420145009/hounsfield。

title: SARFA: Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong generalizability across a variety of segmentation tasks. However, SAM often struggles in situations where the target to be segmented is ambiguous. This poses a problem in medical imaging, where accurate delineation of targets such as tumors is vital, but even expert radiologists can disagree on the appropriate boundary for a target. Addressing this, we propose SARFA (Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment), a novel framework for improved medical image segmentation. Via probabilistic prompting, SARFA generates a diverse set of plausible masks for each input image and optimizes them with a radiomics-driven training objective based on Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). By minimizing the FRD between masked predicted and ground truth regions within each image, SARFA encourages segmentation outputs whose anatomical and textural characteristics align with clinically meaningful ground truth representations, without relying solely on pixel-level overlap. Evaluated on computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) benchmarks, SARFA outperforms existing ambiguous segmentation methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of radiomic feature alignment and DPO-style candidate mask ranking as a training objective. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbwa233/SARFA.
tldr: SARFA improves SAM for ambiguous medical image segmentation by using radiomic feature alignment (Fréchet Radiomic Distance) and DPO-based candidate mask ranking, outperforming existing methods on CT and MRI.
tldr_zh: SARFA通过放射组学特征对齐（Fréchet Radiomic Distance）和基于DPO的候选掩膜排序，改进了SAM在模糊医学图像分割中的表现，在CT和MRI上优于现有方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：
Segment Anything Model（SAM）已在多种分割任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，当待分割目标存在歧义时，SAM常会陷入困境。这在医学影像中尤为突出——准确勾勒肿瘤等目标边界至关重要，但即使是资深放射科医生也可能对目标的合适边界存在分歧。针对这一问题，我们提出SARFA（放射组学特征对齐的任意分割模型），一种用于改进医学图像分割的新型框架。通过概率提示，SARFA为每张输入图像生成一组多样化的合理掩膜，并基于Fréchet放射组学距离（FRD）和直接偏好优化（DPO），以放射组学驱动的训练目标对掩膜进行优化。通过最小化每张图像中掩膜预测区域与真实区域之间的FRD，SARFA促使分割输出的解剖和纹理特征与临床有意义的真实标注对齐，而不仅仅依赖像素级重叠。在计算机断层扫描（CT）和磁共振成像（MRI）基准数据集上的评估表明，SARFA优于现有的模糊分割方法，验证了放射组学特征对齐和DPO式候选掩膜排序作为训练目标的有效性。我们的代码开源在https://github.com/tbwa233/SARFA。

title: Layered Risk Mapping for Autonomous Patient Transport in Expeditionary Medical Facilities
summary: In expeditionary medical facilities, routine patient transport imposes a compounding burden of personal protective equipment consumption, staff diversion, and elevated infection risk that becomes unsustainable under surge conditions. While autonomous wheelchairs could absorb this operational load, the safety-critical nature of patient transit within these highly unstructured and dynamic environments poses complex navigational challenges. To address this, we present a layered risk mapping framework that fuses four heterogeneous environmental hazards (terrain slope, static and dynamic obstacles, and semantic traversability) into a unified probabilistic cost surface via a Noisy-OR fusion model. In a paired Monte-Carlo evaluation, risk-informed fusion reduces collision rates from over 73% to under 32% and more than doubles obstacle clearance relative to a risk-unaware baseline. Additionaly, Noisy-OR achieves the highest clearance to obstacles and the lowest conditional peak risk across all tested hazard densities. We further validate the framework on a commercial powered wheelchair across three representative mission profiles in indoor and outdoor deployments, demonstrating that this architecture successfully meets the planning requirements of this previously unaddressed operational regime.
tldr: This paper proposes a layered risk mapping framework using Noisy-OR fusion to combine terrain, static/dynamic obstacles, and semantic traversability for autonomous wheelchair navigation in expeditionary medical facilities, reducing collision rates from 73% to under 32% in simulation and validated on a real wheelchair across indoor/outdoor missions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层风险映射框架，采用Noisy-OR融合方法将地形坡度、静态/动态障碍物和语义可通行性结合，用于远征医疗设施中自主轮椅导航，在模拟中将碰撞率从73%降至32%以下，并在真实轮椅的室内外任务中验证。
summary_zh: 在远征医疗设施中，常规患者运输会带来个人防护装备消耗、人员分流和感染风险增加的复合负担，在激增条件下将变得不可持续。尽管自动轮椅可承担这一操作负荷，但在这些高度非结构化且动态变化的环境中进行患者转运具有安全关键性，面临复杂的导航挑战。为此，我们提出一种分层风险映射框架，通过噪声或（Noisy-OR）融合模型将四种异质环境危害（地形坡度、静态与动态障碍物以及语义可穿越性）统一为概率代价曲面。在配对蒙特卡洛评估中，与不感知风险的基线相比，风险感知融合将碰撞率从超过73%降至低于32%，并将障碍物避让距离提升一倍以上。此外，在所有测试危害密度下，噪声或模型实现了最高的障碍物避让距离和最低的条件峰值风险。我们进一步在一款商用电动轮椅上，针对室内与室外部署中的三种代表性任务场景验证了该框架，结果表明该架构成功满足了这一此前未被涉及的操作场景的规划需求。

title: AI-Augmented Adaptive Digital Twin Modeling for Brain Tumor Evolution Prediction and Treatment Scheduling
summary: Brain tumor progression exhibits spatially heterogeneous growth, patient-specific treatment response, and complex interactions with surrounding anatomy, making accurate long-term prediction challenging. We propose an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin (DT) framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling. The framework integrates an interpretable reaction--diffusion (RD) model, a 3D residual learning module for model-form correction, patient-specific DT updating during recursive rollout, and model predictive control (MPC) for constrained chemotherapy and radiotherapy scheduling. Experiments on 387 synthetic tumor trajectories with 120-step evolution show that the baseline RD model captures tumor location and overall temporal behavior but underestimates heterogeneous tumor burden during long-horizon prediction. Hybrid RD--residual modeling reduces masked voxel-wise mean squared error by 84.3% and increases Dice overlap by 43.5% relative to the RD baseline under dense simulated observations. Online DT updating further reduces mean squared error by 45.9% and improves Dice overlap by 9.6% compared with the non-updated hybrid model. In MPC-based scheduling simulations, the updated DT controller reduces final tumor burden by 22.4% relative to a fixed treatment schedule under the terminal-burden objective. Together, these results demonstrate a unified framework for patient-specific initialization, mechanistic modeling, adaptive learning, and constrained treatment optimization. Although validated using patient-data-informed synthetic trajectories rather than clinical longitudinal data, the proposed framework establishes a foundation for future translation to real-world adaptive treatment planning.
tldr: This paper proposes an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling, integrating a reaction-diffusion model, 3D residual learning, online updating, and model predictive control, achieving significant error reduction in synthetic experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种AI增强的自适应数字孪生框架，用于脑肿瘤演化预测和治疗调度，集成了反应-扩散模型、3D残差学习、在线更新和模型预测控制，在合成实验中实现了显著的误差降低。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
脑肿瘤进展表现出空间异质性生长、患者特异性治疗反应以及与周围解剖结构的复杂相互作用，这使得准确的长期预测极具挑战性。我们提出了一种基于人工智能增强的自适应数字孪生（DT）框架，用于脑肿瘤演化预测及治疗调度。该框架集成了可解释的反应-扩散（RD）模型、用于模型形式校正的3D残差学习模块、递归展开过程中的患者特异性DT更新，以及用于约束性化疗和放疗调度的模型预测控制（MPC）。在包含387条合成肿瘤轨迹（每轨迹120步演化）的实验中，基线RD模型能够捕捉肿瘤位置与整体时间行为，但在长期预测中低估了异质性肿瘤负荷。在密集模拟观测条件下，混合RD-残差建模相较于RD基线将掩膜体素级均方误差降低了84.3%，并使得Dice重叠度提升了43.5%。与非更新的混合模型相比，在线DT更新进一步将均方误差降低了45.9%，并将Dice重叠度提升了9.6%。在基于MPC的调度仿真中，相较于终端负荷目标下的固定治疗方案，更新后的DT控制器将最终肿瘤负荷降低了22.4%。综合来看，这些结果展示了一个集患者特异性初始化、机理建模、自适应学习与约束性治疗优化于一体的统一框架。尽管该框架使用的是基于患者数据生成的合成轨迹而非临床纵向数据，但它为未来向真实世界自适应治疗规划的转化奠定了基础。

title: TEDDY: A Pediatric Foundation Model for Risk Forewarning from ICD-Coded Diagnostic Histories
summary: Pediatric electronic health records capture developmentally structured clinical trajectories, yet their potential for generative healthcare foundation models remains largely unexplored. Here we present TEDDY (Temporal Event Decoder for Disease in Youth), a 1.84-million-parameter decoder transformer trained on approximately 73 million ICD-10 diagnoses from 1.6 million children at a single pediatric institution. TEDDY models longitudinal diagnosis trajectories and visit timing. Predictions were made before visit codes were revealed, limited to first occurrences, and evaluated against sex- and age-matched controls. Across 797 disease-onset prediction tasks spanning 16 ICD-10 chapters, TEDDY achieved a median AUC of 72.0%, outperforming same-data DenseNet (50.0%), CNN (57.2%), RNN (60.1%), and LSTM (62.7%) baselines on 96-99% of tasks. Performance held across sex and age and was strongest among lower-prevalence diagnoses; 202 of the 225 rarest conditions (90%) had 95% confidence intervals above chance. Predictive signal remained detectable more than two years before first recorded diagnosis, with median AUCs of 59.7% in the unrestricted analysis and 64.4% in a fixed-cohort sensitivity analysis. In asthma and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder benchmarks, AUCs were 79.3% and 84.7%, compared with 62.7% and 71.7% for the strongest comparators, including a general-purpose language model three orders of magnitude larger. Visit-timing predictions had a 3.0-day mean absolute restricted mean survival-time error over 365 days, although median and long-tail return intervals remained miscalibrated. Together, these results establish pediatric diagnostic histories as a substrate for compact generative models supporting broad, rare-disease, and long-horizon risk forecasting without population-scale data or billion-parameter models.
tldr: TEDDY is a 1.84-million-parameter decoder transformer trained on 73 million ICD-10 diagnoses from 1.6 million children, achieving median AUC of 72% across 797 disease-onset prediction tasks and outperforming larger models, demonstrating that compact generative models can support broad and rare-disease risk forecasting from pediatric diagnostic histories.
tldr_zh: TEDDY是一个184万参数的解码器Transformer，在160万儿童的7300万条ICD-10诊断记录上训练，在797个疾病发病预测任务中达到中位AUC 72%，优于更大模型，表明紧凑的生成模型能够从儿科诊断历史支持广泛和罕见疾病的风险预测。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
儿科电子健康记录记录了基于发育结构的临床轨迹，但其在生成式医疗基础模型中的潜力尚待探索。本文提出TEDDY（青少年疾病时间事件解码器），这是一个包含184万个参数的解码器变换器模型，基于单一儿科机构约160万名儿童的约7300万条ICD-10诊断数据进行训练。TEDDY对纵向诊断轨迹和就诊时间进行建模。预测在就诊代码揭示前完成，仅针对首次发病事件，并与性别和年龄匹配的对照组进行对比评估。在涵盖16个ICD-10章节的797项疾病发病预测任务中，TEDDY的中位AUC达72.0%，在96%-99%的任务上优于同一数据集的DenseNet（50.0%）、CNN（57.2%）、RNN（60.1%）和LSTM（62.7%）基线模型。其性能在性别和年龄分层中保持稳定，且在低患病率诊断中表现最强；225种最罕见疾病中有202种（90%）的95%置信区间高于随机水平。预测信号在首次记录诊断前两年以上即可检测到，无限制分析的中位AUC为59.7%，固定队列敏感性分析中为64.4%。在哮喘和注意力缺陷/多动症基准测试中，AUC分别达到79.3%和84.7%，而最强对比模型（包括规模大三个数量级的通用语言模型）分别为62.7%和71.7%。就诊时间预测在365天内的平均绝对受限平均生存时间误差为3.0天，但中位和长尾返回间隔仍存在校准偏差。综上，这些结果表明儿科诊断历史可作为紧凑生成模型的基座，无需群体规模数据或数十亿参数模型即可支持广泛、罕见疾病及远期风险预测。

title: FM$^2$: Unified Federated Foundation Models for Heterogeneous Multimodal Medical Imaging
summary: Building foundation models for medical imaging requires pooling data across institutions, yet privacy regulations prohibit centralized aggregation. Existing Federated Foundation Models either fine-tune natural-image models with poor medical-domain transfer, or train from scratch within a single modality, lacking the flexibility to unify tasks. We identify an under-explored challenge, Imaging Modality Heterogeneity, where clients operate under two structural regimes: Overlapped (shared modalities with heterogeneous label distributions) and Non-overlapped (fully disjoint modalities per client). We propose FM$^2$, a unified framework that trains the core backbone from scratch to preserve medical domain fidelity while optionally incorporating biomedical pretrained encoders for vision-language alignment. FM$^2$ equips each client with dual Mixture-of-Experts modules (a Class-wise MoE for personalized category knowledge and a Domain-wise MoE for shared cross-modality representations), coupled with a Heterogeneous Modality Alignment (HMA) regularizer that explicitly aligns modality-specific expert parameters, admitting provable $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence and generalization guarantees. FM$^2$ further incorporates Caption-Enhanced Learning (CEL), where locally retained GPT-4o-generated captions serve as a textual semantic bridge enabling representation transfer across clients with disjoint modalities, and demonstrates extensibility to Federated Medical VQA. Experiments on our MIMH benchmark (classification and CEL) and real-world medical VQA datasets confirm consistent superiority over state-of-the-art federated baselines and strong out-of-modality generalization across all three tasks.
tldr: A federated learning framework (FM^2) for training multimodal medical imaging foundation models across clients with heterogeneous modalities, using mixture-of-experts and a modality alignment regularizer to handle overlapped and non-overlapped modality settings, with demonstrated superiority on classification and VQA tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种联邦学习框架FM^2，用于在具有异构模态的客户端之间训练多模态医学影像基础模型，通过混合专家模型和模态对齐正则化处理重叠和非重叠模态设置，在分类和VQA任务上表现优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 为医学影像构建基础模型需要跨机构汇集数据，但隐私法规禁止集中式数据聚合。现有联邦基础模型要么对医学领域迁移效果欠佳的自然图像模型进行微调，要么在单模态内从头训练，缺乏统一任务的灵活性。我们发现了一个尚未充分探索的挑战——成像模态异质性，在此场景下各客户端运行于两种结构模式：重叠模式（共享模态但标签分布异质）和非重叠模式（各客户端拥有完全不相交的模态）。我们提出FM$^2$，一个统一框架，从头训练核心骨干网络以保留医学领域保真度，同时可选地集成生物医学预训练编码器以实现视觉-语言对齐。FM$^2$为每个客户端配备双专家混合模块（类别级MoE用于个性化类别知识，领域级MoE用于共享跨模态表示），并引入异质模态对齐（HMA）正则化器，显式对齐模态特定的专家参数，可证明具有$O(1/\sqrt{T})$的收敛速度和泛化保证。FM$^2$进一步集成描述增强学习（CEL），其中本地保留的GPT-4o生成的描述作为文本语义桥梁，使不相交模态的客户端间能够进行表示迁移，并展现出扩展到联邦医学视觉问答的可扩展性。在MIMH基准测试（分类和CEL）以及真实医学VQA数据集上的实验证实，该方法在所有三项任务中均持续优于最先进的联邦基线方法，并具备强大的跨模态泛化能力。
